title: Heat Pipe
definition: A heat pipe moves thermal energy through evaporation and condensation inside a sealed enclosure. A conventional spacecraft design has an evaporator at the heat source, a vapour passage, a condenser coupled to a cooler sink and a porous or grooved wick. Heat vaporises the working fluid; the vapour flows down its pressure gradient and condenses; capillary pressure in the wick returns liquid to the evaporator.[^1][^2]
